# Minify HTML (community, Node only)

Removes HTML comments and whitespace between tags from the final document (`render.after`, stage `transform`). It leaves the contents of `script`, `style`, `pre` and `textarea` alone, except the leading whitespace of an inline script.

<!-- implements:start (generated by scripts/plugin-docs.mjs from plugin.yaml and the docblocks in the code; do not edit by hand) -->
## What it implements

| Kind | Name | Runs when | What this plugin does |
|---|---|---|---|
| hook | `render.after` | the document is complete (stage transform) | Removes comments and extra whitespace from the finished HTML, leaving script, style, pre and textarea contents untouched. |
